Write a short incident update for the engineering channel from these notes.

deploy v2.14 went out 14:05. 14:12 error rate on /api/orders jumped from 0.2% to 6%. rolled back 14:20, errors back to normal 14:22. cause: the new orders query used a column that doesn't exist on the EU replica (migration only ran on US). about 400 failed order submissions during the window, customers saw a generic error, nobody was double-charged (payment happens after order create). fix: run the migration on EU, add a check in the deploy pipeline that migrations ran on all replicas before the app deploys. re-deploy planned tomorrow 10:00 after the migration. need: Priya to confirm the EU migration tonight.

response.text:
**Incident update:** v2.14 was deployed at 14:05. At 14:12, errors on `/api/orders` rose from 0.2% to 6%. We rolled back at 14:20, and errors returned to normal by 14:22.

The new orders query referenced a column missing from the EU replica because the migration ran only on US. About 400 order submissions failed during the incident; customers saw a generic error. No one was double-charged, as payment happens after order creation.

**Next steps:** Priya to confirm the EU migration tonight. We’ll add a deploy-pipeline check to ensure migrations ran on all replicas before app deployment, then plan to redeploy tomorrow at 10:00 after the migration.
